Title: Public preview: Windows 10 Enterprise State Roaming preview via Azure Active Directory Premium is now available in Asia

Body.Content:
In Windows 10, Enterprise State Roaming brings the settings sync experience, which Microsoft account sign-in provides to consumers, to enterprise users. Through Azure Active Directory Join, users can use their organizational identities to roam their settings and modern app data using Azure cloud for storage. Enterprise users benefit from a unified experience across their Azure Active Directory–joined Windows 10 devices. They are also protected from modern app data loss due to hardware failure, theft, or device replacement. Enterprises benefit from enhanced security and better control of the enterprise data. All data is encrypted with Azure Rights Management before leaving the device. This capability is available only with an Azure Active Directory Premium subscription.

Enterprise State Roaming preview for Windows 10 is now available in the East and Southeast Asia Azure regions.
